name: TIME Magazine Reader
description: Clean article reading on TIME with dark mode for TV

params.css: body { background: #0d1117 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; } .ad, [class*='ad-'], [class*='newsletter'], aside, [class*='paywall'] { display: none !important; } .article-body p { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.8 !important; color: #c9d1d9 !important; } h1 { font-size: 34px !important; color: #58a6ff !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; } .article-body { max-width: 900px !important; margin: 0 auto !important; padding: 20px 40px !important; }
